mapper.select: SELECT asset.* , NVL(SUM(sub.SMV),0) UNINVEST_CASH, GREATEST(asset.UPDATE_TIME1,nvl(asset.UPDATE_TIME2,asset.UPDATE_TIME1)) UPDATE_TIME FROM (SELECT sub.VAL_DATE POS_DATE, sub.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID ASSET_CODE, info2.REP_CCY CCY, /***调整 资产涉及2开头的科目要减，不是全加（科目名称是资产名称，科目代码2开头）**/ NVL(SUM(decode(substr(sub.SUB_CODE,0,1),'2',0,sub.SECURITY_QUANTITY)),0)*DECODE(fp.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F01',100,1) POS_NUM, NVL(SUM(decode(substr(sub.SUB_CODE,0,1),'2',ABS(sub.SMV)*-1,sub.SMV)),0) POS_AMT, /***调整 资产涉及2开头的科目要减，不是全加（科目名称是资产名称，科目代码2开头）**/ sumsub.TOTAL_NUM TOTAL_NUM, max(nvl(sub.CREATE_TIME,sub.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME1, sumsub.UPDATE_TIME UPDATE_TIME2 FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB sub /*获取底层资产的公开市场代码*/ LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT info ON info.REP_FINPROD_ID = sub.FINPROD_ID /*判断是否为债券*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = sub.FINPROD_ID /*获取资管计划币种*/ LEFT JOIN REP_ASSET_DEPT info2 ON info2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = sub.PTL_ID /*判断资管计划是否存在*/ LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp2 ON fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID = sub.PTL_ID LEFT JOIN (SELECT NVL(SUM(SMV),0) TOTAL_NUM, VAL_DATE, PTL_ID, max(nvl(CREATE_TIME,UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB WHERE SUB_CODE = '601' GROUP BY VAL_DATE, PTL_ID ) sumsub ON sumsub.VAL_DATE = sub.VAL_DATE AND sub.PTL_ID = sumsub.PTL_ID WHERE 1 =1 AND sub.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND sub.FINPROD_ID IS NOT NULL --AND info2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID IS NOT NULL and fp2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID is not null GROUP BY sub.VAL_DATE, sub.PTL_ID, info.FINPROD_MARKET_ID, sumsub.TOTAL_NUM, info2.REP_CCY, fp.FINPROD_TYPE2, sumsub.UPDATE_TIME ) asset LEFT JOIN RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB sub ON sub.VAL_DATE = asset.POS_DATE AND sub.PTL_ID = asset.PLAN_ASSET_ID AND (sub.SUB_CODE IN ('1002','1031','1021') or (sub.SUB_CODE like '3003__')) GROUP BY asset.POS_DATE, asset.PLAN_ASSET_ID, asset.ASSET_CODE, asset.POS_NUM, asset.POS_AMT, asset.TOTAL_NUM, asset.CCY, asset.UPDATE_TIME1, asset.UPDATE_TIME2

select distinct VAL_DATE from( select VAL_DATE from RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB where nvl(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} union all select VAL_DATE from RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB where nvl(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} )

with rate as( SELECT BASIS_CYY ccyOriginal, QUOT_CYY ccyConvert, TRADE_DATE publishDate, case when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then CLOSE_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' then OPEN_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '03' then HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '04' then LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '05' then MID_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) end yeid FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE info where info.QUOT_CYY = 'CNY' AND INFO.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and info.TRADE_DATE = (select max(t.TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.BASIS_CYY = info.BASIS_CYY and t.QUOT_CYY = info.QUOT_CYY AND t.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and to_char(t.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') <=#{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ), bok as ( select re.CHANNEL_ID SEC_ACCT_ID, sum(nvl(bok.B_AMT,0)) O_AMT, max(nvl(bok.UPDATE_TIME,bok.CREATE_TIME)) as UPDATE_TIME from bok_balance bok left join BOK_BOOKSET_RE re on bok.BOOKSET_ID=re.BOOKSET_ID_SON and bok.SUBJECT_NO='4001' and to_char(bok.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where re.CHANNEL_ID is not null group by re.CHANNEL_ID ), pos as ( select pos.CHL_FINPROD_ID as SEC_ACCT_ID,sum(nvl(pos.AMOUNT,0)*decode(pos.ccy,'CNY',1,nvl(rate1.yeid,0))) as UNINVEST_CASH from PTL_CASH_POSITION pos left join rate rate1 on rate1.ccyOriginal=pos.ccy where to_char(pos.cdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pos.HODING_TYPE='03' and pos.CHL_FINPROD_ID is not null group by pos.CHL_FINPROD_ID ) select * from ( select val.cdate as POS_DATE, dept.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as PLAN_ASSET_ID, nvl(dept1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,ftp.finprod_id) as ASSET_CODE, sum(nvl(bok.O_AMT,0)) as TOTAL_NUM, sum(nvl(bok.O_AMT,0)*decode(nvl(info.ccy,trd.ccy),'CNY',1,nvl(rate.yeid,0))) as ISSUE_AMT, sum(nvl(pos.UNINVEST_CASH,0)) as UNINVEST_CASH,
SUM(nvl(val.share_amt,0)*decode(info1.finprod_type2,'F01',100,1))AS POS_NUM, sum((nvl(val.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+nvl(val.DSC_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(val.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)+nvl(val.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0))*decode( nvl(info1.ccy,ftp.ccy) ,'CNY',1,nvl(rate1.yeid,0))) as POS_AMT, '02' as ISCHL, GREATEST(max(nvl(val.UPDATE_TIME,val.CREATE_TIME)),max(nvl(bok.UPDATE_TIME,date'1900-01-01'))) UPDATE_TIME from ptl_sec_valution val left join fin_product fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_ID=val.FINPROD_ID left join rep_asset_dept dept on dept.REP_FINPROD_ID=val.SEC_ACCT_ID left join rep_asset_dept dept1 on dept1.REP_FINPROD_ID=nvl(fp1.P_FINPROD_ID,fp1.FINPROD_ID) left join fin_trade_product ftp on ftp.finprod_id = val.FINPROD_ID left join bok on bok.SEC_ACCT_ID=val.SEC_ACCT_ID left join pos on pos.SEC_ACCT_ID=val.SEC_ACCT_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO stl on stl.sec_acct_id=val.sec_acct_id left join fin_product info on info.FINPROD_ID=val.SEC_ACCT_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT trd on trd.FINPROD_ID=val.SEC_ACCT_ID left join fin_product info1 on info1.FINPROD_ID=val.FINPROD_ID left join rate on rate.ccyOriginal=nvl(info.ccy,trd.ccy) left join rate rate1 on rate1.ccyOriginal=nvl(info1.ccy,ftp.ccy) where val.sec_acct_id!='999999' and stl.sec_acct_id is null and (dept1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID is not null or (ftp.finprod_type2 in ('F02','F03','F04','F05') and ftp.finprod_id is not null)) and to_char(val.cdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = val.PORTFOLIO_ID) group by val.cdate,dept.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,nvl(dept1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,ftp.finprod_id) )

with rate as( SELECT BASIS_CYY ccyOriginal, QUOT_CYY ccyConvert, TRADE_DATE publishDate, case when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '02' then CLOSE_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '01' then OPEN_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '03' then HIGH_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '04' then LOW_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) when #{status,jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '05' then MID_PRICE/(case when info.QUOT_UNIT=0 then 1 else info.QUOT_UNIT end) end yeid FROM MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE info where info.QUOT_CYY = 'CNY' AND INFO.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and info.TRADE_DATE = (select max(t.TRADE_DATE) from MST_EXCHARGE_QUOTE t where t.BASIS_CYY = info.BASIS_CYY and t.QUOT_CYY = info.QUOT_CYY AND t.DATASOURCE_TYPE = 'SAFE' and to_char(t.TRADE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') <=#{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ), bok as ( select re.CHANNEL_ID SEC_ACCT_ID, sum(nvl(bok.B_AMT,0)) O_AMT, max(nvl(bok.UPDATE_TIME,bok.CREATE_TIME)) as UPDATE_TIME from bok_balance bok left join BOK_BOOKSET_RE re on bok.BOOKSET_ID=re.BOOKSET_ID_SON and bok.SUBJECT_NO='4001' and to_char(bok.BALANCE_DATE,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} where re.CHANNEL_ID is not null group by re.CHANNEL_ID ), pos as ( select pos.CHL_FINPROD_ID as SEC_ACCT_ID,sum(nvl(pos.AMOUNT,0)*decode(pos.ccy,'CNY',1,nvl(rate1.yeid,0))) as UNINVEST_CASH from PTL_CASH_POSITION pos left join rate rate1 on rate1.ccyOriginal=pos.ccy where to_char(pos.cdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and pos.HODING_TYPE='03' and pos.CHL_FINPROD_ID is not null group by pos.CHL_FINPROD_ID ) select * from ( select val.cdate as POS_DATE, t1.chl_id as PLAN_ASSET_ID, dept1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID as ASSET_CODE, sum(nvl(bok.O_AMT,0)) as TOTAL_NUM, sum(nvl(bok.O_AMT,0)*decode(nvl(info.ccy,trd.ccy),'CNY',1,nvl(rate.yeid,0))) as ISSUE_AMT, sum(nvl(pos.UNINVEST_CASH,0)) as UNINVEST_CASH,
SUM(nvl(val.share_amt,0)*decode(info1.finprod_type2,'F01',100,1))AS POS_NUM,-- 如果是债券则需要乘以100 --> sum((nvl(val.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+nvl(val.DSC_COST_AMT,0)+nvl(val.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)+nvl(val.DELAY_PAY_AMT,0))*decode(
info1.ccy ,'CNY',1,nvl(rate1.yeid,0))) as POS_AMT, '02' as ISCHL, GREATEST(max(nvl(val.UPDATE_TIME,val.CREATE_TIME)),max(nvl(bok.UPDATE_TIME,date'1900-01-01'))) UPDATE_TIME from ptl_sec_valution val left join fin_product fp1 on fp1.FINPROD_ID=val.FINPROD_ID
left join rep_asset_dept dept1 on dept1.REP_FINPROD_ID=nvl(fp1.P_FINPROD_ID,fp1.FINPROD_ID) inner join (select DISTINCT fp.finprod_market_id asset_id,FP1.FINPROD_ID,fp1.finprod_market_id chl_id from fin_cash_info ca left join fin_product fp on FP.FINPROD_ID=CA.FINPROD_ID left join fin_product fp1 on FP1.FINPROD_ID=CA.CHL_FINPROD_ID left join fin_product_type tp on tp.FINPROD_ID=FP.FINPROD_ID where TP.TYPE_8 IN('F06','F03'
,'F05'
) and CA.CHL_FINPROD_ID is not null) t1 on T1.asset_id=dept1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join bok on bok.SEC_ACCT_ID=t1.FINPROD_ID left join pos on pos.SEC_ACCT_ID=t1.FINPROD_ID left join STL_SEC_ACCT_INFO stl on stl.sec_acct_id=t1.FINPROD_ID left join fin_product info on info.FINPROD_ID=t1.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT trd on trd.FINPROD_ID=t1.FINPROD_ID left join fin_product info1 on info1.FINPROD_ID=val.FINPROD_ID
left join rate on rate.ccyOriginal=nvl(info.ccy,trd.ccy) left join rate rate1 on rate1.ccyOriginal= info1.ccy where (val.sec_acct_id='999999' or stl.sec_acct_id is not null) and dept1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID is not null and to_char(val.cdate,'yyyy-mm-dd') = #{batchTime,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and exists( select 1 from FIN_PRODUCT_ADD fp3 where fp3.PORTFOLIO_ID = val.PORTFOLIO_ID) group by val.cdate,t1.chl_id,dept1.FINPROD_MARKET_ID )
select distinct CDATE from ptl_sec_valution where nvl(UPDATE_TIME,CREATE_TIME) > #{batchTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}

SELECT SUB.VAL_DATE AS POS_DATE, SUB.PTL_ID AS PLAN_ASSET_ID, SUM(nvl(SUB.SMV,0)) AS POS_AMT, SUM(nvl(SUB.SMV_ORI,0)) AS O_UNINVEST_CASH FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 活期存款、清算款、备付金、保证金**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002','1021','1031','3003') GROUP BY SUB.VAL_DATE,SUB.PTL_ID

SELECT HZ.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID, HZ.SUB_CODE ASSET_CODE, SUM(nvl(SMV,0)) POS_AMT, SUM(IFNULL(HZ.SMV_ORI,0)) O_UNINVEST_CASH FROM RSK_VALTBL_SUM_ASSET_SUB HZ WHERE HZ.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 实收资本、资产净值**/ AND HZ.SUB_CODE IN ('601', '701') GROUP BY HZ.PTL_ID,HZ.SUB_CODE

SELECT SUB.VAL_DATE POS_DATE,/** 持仓日期**/ SUB.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID,/** 资管计划行内资产/负债编码**/ SUB.SUB_CODE ASSET_CODE, SUM(nvl(SUB.SMV,0)) POS_AMT, SUM(IFNULL(SUB.SMV_ORI,0)) O_UNINVEST_CASH, MAX(nvl(SUB.CREATE_TIME, SUB.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 上交所买入返售证券、银行间买入返售、深交所买入返售证券、应收买入返售证券利息 上交所卖出回购证券款、银行间卖出回购证券款、深交所卖出回购证券款、应付回购利息**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('120201','120202','120203','120410','220201','220202','220203','223101') GROUP BY SUB.VAL_DATE,SUB.PTL_ID,SUB.SUB_CODE

SELECT ASSET_CODE assetCode, CHECK_CODE checkCode, TARGET_AMT targetAmt, ASSET_TYPE2 assetType2, TRADE_MARKET tradeMarket, CCY ccy FROM chb_asset_info WHERE ASSET_TYPE2 IN ('1108','1902') AND STATUS IN ('E','M') and #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE}>=VDATE AND MDATE>#{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE}

SELECT SUB.VAL_DATE POS_DATE,/** 持仓日期**/ SUB.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID,/** 资管计划行内资产/负债编码**/ 'REMAININGCASH' ASSET_CODE,/** 行内资产/负债编码**/ SUM(CASE WHEN SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002', '1021', '1031', '3003') THEN nvl(SUB.SMV,0) ELSE 0 END) UNINVEST_CASH,/** 未投资头寸**/ SUM(CASE WHEN SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002', '1021', '1031', '3003') THEN nvl(SUB.SMV,0) ELSE 0 END) POS_NUM,/** 持仓数量**/ SUM(nvl(SUB.SMV,0)) POS_AMT, /** 底层资产折算人民币币值（元）**/ SUM(CASE WHEN SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('120401','120402','120403') THEN nvl(SUB.SMV, 0) ELSE 0 END) INT_AMT, /** 利息**/ MAX(nvl(SUB.CREATE_TIME, SUB.UPDATE_TIME)) UPDATE_TIME FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 活期存款、清算款、备付金、保证金**/
AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002', '1021', '1031', '3003','120401','120402','120403')
AND SUB.SUB_CODE IN ('1002', '1021', '1031', '3003')
GROUP BY SUB.VAL_DATE,SUB.PTL_ID

SELECT SUB.PTL_ID PLAN_ASSET_ID,/** 资管计划行内资产/负债编码**/ COUNT(1) ASSET_CODE /** 其他科目数量**/ FROM RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB SUB WHERE SUB.VAL_DATE = #{batchTime,jdbcType=DATE} /** 除活期存款1002、清算款3003、应收银行活期存款利息120401**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '1002%' /** 排除活期存款1002**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '3003%' /** 排除清算款3003**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '120401%' /** 排除应收银行活期存款利息120401**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2206%' /** 排除应付管理人报酬2206**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2207%' /** 排除应付托管费2207**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2209%' /** 排除应付交易费用2209**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2221%' /** 排除应付税费2221**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2222%' /** 排除预估税费2222**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2501%' /** 排除预提费用2501**/ AND SUB.SUB_CODE NOT LIKE '2801%' /** 排除其他应付款2801**/ GROUP BY SUB.PTL_ID

select ASSET_CODE assetCode, CCY ccy from CHB_ASSET_INFO WHERE STATUS !='D' and ASSET_TYPE2 in ( select SRCFIELD1 from CHB_TYPE_MAPPING_EX where MAPPINGCODE = 'ASSET_TYPE2_CATA_TYPE' and OBJFIELD1 IN ('12', '13', '14') )
